table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	purinvcode = dbo.purledger.purinvcode, 
	date = dbo.purledger.date,
	invdiscperc = dbo.purledger.discperc, 
	flatdisc = dbo.purledger.flatdisc, 
	misccharges = dbo.purledger.misccharges,
	invgstperc1 = dbo.purledger.invgstperc1,
	invsalestax = dbo.purledger.salestax,
	invtype = Case dbo.purledger.purcatcode 	When 1 Then 'Cash Purchase' 	
														When 2 Then 'Credit Purchase' 
														When 7 Then 'Loose Purchase Cash'
														When 8 Then 'Loose Purchase Credit'
														Else 'Opening Purchase' End,  	   
	looseqty = dbo.purdetail.looseqty, 
	packqty  = purdetail.packqty, 
	quantity = dbo.purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty, 
	bonusqty  = purdetail.bonusqty, 	  
	price = dbo.purdetail.purprice,    
	unitsalestax = dbo.purdetail.unitsalestax,
	gstperc = dbo.purdetail.gstperc,
	itemdiscperc = dbo.purdetail.discperc,    
	packunits = dbo.purdetail.packunits,    
	packing=  case when (dbo.item.packcode is null) then space(30)
				 else  dbo.itempacking.name
			  end,
	batch = dbo.purdetail.batch,    
	expiry = dbo.purdetail.expiry,    
	itemname = item.name,
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, purledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, purledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, purledger.date)))), 
	Person = dbo.accounts.name,
	Posted= Case dbo.purledger.posted When 'Y' THEN 'YES'
			ELSE
					'NO'
			END,
	saleprice=Case  When ((dbo.purledger.purcatcode=7) OR (dbo.purledger.purcatcode=8)) then purdetail.saleprice / case WHEN purdetail.packunits <> 0 THEN purdetail.packunits ELSE 1 END
			  ELSE     purdetail.saleprice 
			  END,
	margin1= 
	((purdetail.saleprice  - ( purdetail.purprice * (1 - purdetail.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - purledger.discperc * 0.01) )) / 
	CASE 
		WHEN (purdetail.purprice * (1 - purdetail.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - purledger.discperc * 0.01)) <> 0 THEN ( purdetail.purprice * (1 - purdetail.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - purledger.discperc * 0.01) )
		ELSE case when purdetail.saleprice = 0 then 1 else purdetail.saleprice end 
	END) * 100,
	totalsalestax = (SELECT invtotalsalestax= 
								  Round (
	/*invoice level salestax*/Round ( ( Round ( Sum ( Round ( ( PD.looseqty + PD.packqty ) * PD.purprice * (1 - PD.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) )
								 * ( 1 - PL.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) - PL.flatdisc ) * PL.invgstperc1 * 0.01  , 2 )
	/*items salestax*/		 + Sum (Round ( (PD.looseqty + PD.packqty + PD.bonusqty)* PD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round ( (PD.looseqty + PD.packqty) * PD.purprice * (1 - PD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * PD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )						 
								 , ISNULL((SELECT A=dbo.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('roundpurinvon')), 0))
					 FROM dbo.Purledger PL , 
							dbo.Purdetail PD
	
					 WHERE  (PL.purinvcode = dbo.purledger.purinvcode )   and
							  (PL.purinvcode = PD.purinvcode )   
	
					 GROUP BY PL.purinvcode, 
								 PL.invgstperc1, 
								 PL.misccharges,   
								 PL.flatdisc,
								 PL.discperc
					)
	
FROM 	 
	dbo.purledger, 
	dbo.purdetail,    
	dbo.item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON ( dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode),
	dbo.accounts

WHERE  
	dbo.purledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	dbo.purledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	dbo.purledger.purcatcode IN (1, 2, 3, 7, 8) and
	dbo.purledger.suppcode IN (:aa_suppcode) and
	dbo.purledger.purinvcode = dbo.purdetail.purinvcode and  
	dbo.purdetail.icode = item.icode and 
	dbo.purledger.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode 
	
Order by 
	dbo.purledger.purinvcode,
	dbo.purdetail.purrowid

objects.name: c_itemdiscount
objects.expression: Round(((( quantity *   price ) *  ( itemdiscperc *  .01 ) ) + (( quantity *   price )  *   ( 1 - (itemdiscperc *  .01 ) ) )  *  ( 0.01  *  invdiscperc)) , 2)

objects.name: c_totalsalestax
objects.expression: Round ( Sum ( totalsalestax for all distinct purinvcode ) , 0 )

objects.name: c_totalnetpurchaseamount
objects.expression: Round ( Sum( c_amount for all) + sum( misccharges for all distinct  purinvcode ) -  sum(  flatdisc  for all distinct  purinvcode ) , 0 ) /*+ Round ( Sum ( totalsalestax  for all distinct purinvcode ) , 0 ) */

objects.name: c_itemsalestax
objects.expression: Round( (quantity + bonusqty ) * unitsalestax  + Round( (quantity   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * 0.01 )  ) * gstperc * 0.01,2) , 2)

objects.name: c_invpuramount
objects.expression: Round ( Sum (c_amount for group 1) - flatdisc + misccharges , 0 )
